item_short_desc: Rothco's Jumbo Canvas Medic Bag keeps gear protected and secure with a classic military medic look.
description: Rothco's Jumbo Canvas Medic Bag keeps gear protected and secure with a classic military medic look. The medic bag is constructed of a durable cotton canvas. This classic military style shoulder bag features a large main compartment with flap and leather strap closures, which is perfect for storing all of your essential gear and keeping them secure. The shoulder strap is fully adjustable as well. Rothco's Jumbo Canvas Medic Bag measures 15" x 14" x 5" leaving more than enough room to fit everything you need.
